selection: The final extended-search candidate is selected for visible oscillations followed by recovery. Selection is illustrative and outcome-dependent. Final replay is rerun at finer time steps.

searches.scope: Outcome-selected illustration; all candidates retained. Same controller and release conditions; vary common motor lag and available thrust.
